name: [FA] Ahmad Rahimi
quote: [FA] When my family arrived in Phoenix we had nothing. Afghan Support helped us file our asylum paperwork and connected us with housing — all in Dari. I finally felt safe again.

name: [FA] Fatima Noori
quote: [FA] I was so afraid of the immigration process. The team walked me through every step, explained my rights, and helped me get my work permit. They changed my life.

name: [FA] Haji Mohammad
quote: [FA] I have seen many families come through our doors confused and scared. This organization treats every person with dignity. They are a bridge between our old home and our new one.

name: [FA] Zabiullah Ahmadi
quote: [FA] The free legal consultations saved us thousands of dollars. They understood our culture. My green card application is now in process thanks to their help.

name: [FA] Mariam Karimi
quote: [FA] After years of uncertainty, I finally have stability. Afghan Support not only helped with my paperwork but also connected my children with schools and English classes.
